description: Repairs r-cplx-rebuild/att-file-failures: the last two steps (the database file as LoadFromFile source and as SaveToFile destination) hit 3420 on a stale handle. On a writable r-cplx-rebuild-cx-attach, each step uses a FRESHLY acquired recordset, child recordset and FileData field of p1 (p3 for the empty group): SaveToFile to a new work file; SaveToFile onto an existing work file (written by ADODB.Stream); under parent Edit a child AddNew and LoadFromFile of a source that does not exist, Update, CancelUpdate; SaveToFile on the child of the empty group p3; under parent Edit a child AddNew and LoadFromFile whose source is the open database file itself, Update, CancelUpdate; SaveToFile whose destination is the open database file. DBEngine.Errors right after each failing call and the file states after each step; the group of p1 is read at the end.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cat-txn probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
